steps.u: The video thumbnail job silently produces black images for some uploads. No errors in the logs and I do not know where to start. Find out why.

steps.a: The black ones are 10-bit HEVC with an HLG transfer, that is HDR; the good one is plain 8-bit SDR. Our command extracts a frame without tone mapping, so HDR values may collapse to near black in an 8-bit PNG.

i.command: ffmpeg -i sample-bad.mov -frames:v 1 plain.png && python3 mean_brightness.py plain.png
ffmpeg -i sample-bad.mov -vf zscale=t=linear,tonemap=hable,zscale=t=bt709,format=yuv420p -frames:v 1 tonemapped.png && python3 mean_brightness.py tonemapped.png

steps.a: Confirmed: without tone mapping the frame is almost black (brightness 3), with a tone mapping filter chain it is normal (96). The thumbnail code needs to detect HDR and tone map. I have not changed the code yet.

reference.summary: Diagnosed black thumbnails as 10-bit HDR HEVC video extracted without tone mapping: ffprobe separated the HDR files from SDR ones and a tone mapped extraction raised mean brightness from 3 to 96; the code was not changed in this session.
facts: black thumbnails for some uploads, no log errors
bad files are 10-bit HEVC with HLG transfer
extraction without tone mapping gives brightness 3
